ModelTransparencyEffect.luau.description: Allows a model to have transparent set locally on the client. Supports all BasePart types including: - Part - MeshPart - UnionOperation - TrussPart - WedgePart - CornerWedgePart Also supports Decals. Can optionally disable visual effects like ParticleEmitters, Lights, Beams, etc.

ModelTransparencyEffectUtils.luau.description: Identifies visual-effect instances supported by `ModelTransparencyEffect`. Public entry points include `ModelTransparencyEffectUtils.isVisualEffect`.

TransparencyService.luau.description: Service that orchistrates transparency setting from multiple colliding sources and handle the transparency appropriately. This means that 2 systems can work with transparency without knowing about each other. Public entry points include `TransparencyService.Init`, `TransparencyService.IsDead`, `TransparencyService.SetTransparency`, `TransparencyService.SetLocalTransparencyModifier`,…
